request: Extract an event log for each hospital admission, including admission, intra-hospital transfers, and discharge.
questions: Is the intended case an admission (hadm_id) rather than a patient (subject_id)?
Does the requested scope include every admission, including admissions with no transfers?
Do transfer rows represent a unit entry, a unit exit, or both?
Are admission/discharge timestamps duplicated by boundary transfer rows?
Are NULL timestamps excluded without dropping the case population?
Are transfer rows with NULL hadm_id excluded from admission-scoped events?
Does joining by hadm_id preserve exactly one event per qualifying source row and chosen timestamp?
Do event IDs encode source table, row key and timestamp role deterministically?
Does the extracted trace match the reviewed original DB rows?
Has the evaluator independently reviewed the SQL and approved the Gold?
